title: Identification of reactive CpGs and RNA expression in early COVID-19 through cis-eQTM analysis reflecting disease severity and recovery
description: Multi-omics analyses of severe COVID-19 cases are crucial in deciphering the complex interplay between genetic and epigenetic factors. Here, we present an analysis of Expression Quantitative Trait Methylation (eQTM) to investigate the complex interplay of methylation and gene expression pattern during the acute phase of severe COVID-19.
